desc:
You're tiny. The world is huge. Snipe and knife your way across a giant living room, dollhouse and attic.

🎯 Headshots, knives, jump pads and wall jumps
⚔️ Free for All, Team Deathmatch, Gun Game and weekly party modes
🥊 1v1 and 2v2 Duels
🏆 Ranked seasons from Bronze to Champion, with exclusive skins
🐱 Live maps: the cat walks in, storms roll in, the lights go out

⭐ VIP players earn +20% Coins!
👥 Play with friends for +20% Coins!
🎮 PC, phones, tablets, Xbox & PlayStation

👥 Join the Strafe Jump group: 1,000 Coins and a free case
🎁 Code TINYSNIPERS: 500 Coins and a case

🛡️ Cheaters will be banned. Free to play, no pay-to-win.
